text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry.
...Last night, there were a lot of things...
Well, a lot of requests I had to handle...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Because I was... dragging my feet, I ended up going to bed later than I planned.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's not like I haven't slept at all...!
I'm fine... I'm really fine with just this much.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Dantsu Flame wasn't able to rest very well...
